title: Ostomy Supply Program Shared-Need Share for Customers Carrying a Urology and Continence Supply Program Balance
content:
Shared need adds a need share to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base of an Ostomy Supply Program financial-hardship waiver when the customer also carries a continence balance with Larkfield under the Urology and Continence Supply Program.

**Continence balance** is the running total of the patient-balance postings on all of the customer's continence programs: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less patient payments and balance adjustments, rounded to the cent.

| Customer's continence records | Share added |
|---|---|
| An active continence program and a continence balance of USD 100.00 or more | 20% (the higher need share) |
| An active continence program and a continence balance above USD 0.00 and below USD 100.00 | A need share in proportion to that balance: the balance divided by 500.00 |
| Any other customer | Nothing |

The need share is added to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, active continence program).**
- Continence balance USD 100.00: 20% added.
- Continence balance USD 60.00: 60.00 divided by 500.00 is 0.12, so 12% is added.
- Continence balance USD 0.00 or a credit: nothing added.
- Continence balance USD 150.00 but no active continence program: nothing added.
